title: Customer Staircase Intake and Prioritized Sprint Credits
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Introduce a predictable, credit-based intake mechanism (the 'Staircase') for top accounts and escalations that converts validated customer urgency into prioritized sprint credits and partial-scope SLAs. The Staircase reduces ad-hoc firefighting, makes commitment windows explicit, and gives Eng, PM, and Sales a shared currency to reserve near-term capacity for customer-critical work.
business_rationale: We repeatedly get high-touch escalations from strategic customers that bypass normal prioritization. This causes sprint churn, missed OKRs, and non-transparent commitments. By creating a tokenized sprint-credit system tied to validated signals and an expedited admission workflow, we can: 1) reduce context-switch costs, 2) set clear expectations with customers, and 3) measure the opportunity cost of high-touch commitments.
scope_included:
- Intake form + scoring rules for Staircase eligibility.
- Algorithm to translate score -> sprint credits (0.5, 1, 2, 3).
- Operational 'Admission Council' workflow (PM+SE+EM) for final approval.
- Console UI to display reserved credits & committed windows to Sales/CS.
- Telemetry: time-to-admit, delivery rate against credits, customer satisfaction after delivery.
scope_out_of:
- Full automation of score-based approvals for all accounts (we will pilot with top 15 accounts only).
- Billing or contractual SLAs beyond pilot (legal review later).
- Broad product changes not scoped to partial-scope deliveries (must spawn separate tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Intake form published and linked in Sales/CS playbook.
Scoring rules implemented as a serverless function behind intake form.
Staircase credits computed and visible in a simple dashboard (reserved and consumed).
Admission Council exists with documented SLAs: Triage within 48h, decision within 5 business days.
Pilot with top 15 accounts executed; at least 6 admissions completed during pilot period.
Post-delivery NPS follow-up survey sent for every Staircase delivery; baseline satisfaction captured.
tasks: Draft intake form and scoring rubric (PM).
Implement scoring lambda and microservice endpoint (Eng).
Design console widget for reserved credits (Design + Eng).
Run 2-week Admission Council dry runs and iterate SLA language (PM + EM).
Instrument telemetry and create grafana dashboard (Observability).
Pilot onboarding with 15 accounts; collect feedback and revision queue (Customer Success).
metrics: Percentage of Staircase deliveries completed within committed window (target >= 80%)
Average sprint credits consumed per quarter (track cost vs business value)
CS satisfaction for Staircase deliveries (post-delivery survey mean >= 4/5)
Number of emergency hotfixes avoided (compare pre/post pilot)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Pilot, month 0–2): Top 15 accounts, manual Admission Council, console read-only. Phase 2 (month 3–5): Automate scoring + display reserved credits in Console, expand to top 50 accounts, publish SLA template. Phase 3 (month 6+): Evaluate contractual integration (billing/committed SLAs) and expand to Dedicated customers with reserved pools.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Sales/CS may view credits as a promise rather than a discretionary prioritization tool. Mitigation: Clear language in intake and customer comms; require Sales sign-off on scope fraction and publish expected delivery window. Risk: Over-allocation locking engineering capacity. Mitigation: Soft cap per quarter and weekly capacity review with EMs.
